The House met at eleven of the clock,

1. Shri Pramod Kumar (Uttar Pradesh).
2. Shrimati Kanak Lata Singh (Uttar Pradesh).
OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, I refer with profound sorrw to the passing
away of Shri Sis Ram Ola, Minister of Labour and Employment, and sitting Member of
the Lok Sabha, on the 15th December , 2013, at the age of 86 years.
Born in July , 1927, in Jhunjhunu district of Rajasthan, Shri Sis Ram Ola, was
educated at the Education Board, Rajasthan. An agriculturist, political and social worker,
he was associated with several social welfare organisations and was President of Indira
Gandhi Balika Niketan. He was awarded the Padma Shri in the year 1968 for social work.
Shri Sis Ram Ola started his legislative career as a Member of the Rajasthan
Legislative Assembly in 1957. He was a Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly
from 1957 to 1990, and again from 1993 to 1996. He held several ministerial portfolios
in the Government of Rajasthan like Panchayati Raj, Rural Development, irrigation and
others spanning over ten years.
He was also a Member of the Eleventh, Twelfth, Thirteenth, Fourteenth and the
current Fifteenth Lok Sabha. In the Union Government, he served as Minister of State
(Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers from 1996-97, as
Minister of Water Resources (Independent Char ge) from 1997-98, as Minister of Mines
from 2004-09 and as Minister of Labour and Employment from June, 2013, till his sad
demise.
In the passing away of Shri Sis Ram Ola, the country has lost an able administrator
and a distinguished Parliamentarian.

We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri Sis Ram Ola.
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of respect
to the memory of the departed.
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute)
MR. CHAIRMAN: Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved
family our sense of sorrow and deep sympathy . As a mark of respect to the memory
of Shri Sis Ram Ola, Minister of Labour and Employment, the House stands adjourned
till 11.00 
A.M. on Tuesday, the 17th December , 2013.
The House then adjourned at six minutes past eleven of the clock till
eleven of the clock on Tuesday, the 17th December , 2013.
